name: Warwick Mills Inc
old_description: Warwick specializes in weaving high-strength polyester, nylon, and polypropylene fibers. We are also experts in adhesion, using custom RFL and isocyanate formulas to bond textiles and rubber based upon your application's individual requirements.
about:
Warwick Mills operates from New Ipswich, New Hampshire, where it has maintained a 135-plus year history in fabric engineering. The company's roots trace back to the late 19th century, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family or veteran status are not stated in available sources.

The company specializes in engineering technical textiles for protective applications. Its core capabilities include custom weaving of high-strength polyester, nylon, and polypropylene fibers; textile lamination; custom adhesive formulation using RFL and isocyanate chemistries; and performance coating. Warwick integrates research, development, testing, and full-scale manufacturing to produce custom roll goods, fabric laminates, chemical-biological barriers, fabrics for inflatable structures, and flexible composite materials.

Warwick serves the safety, aerospace, and outdoor industries, as well as the bicycle tire sector. A noted partnership with European manufacturer Bohle produced the TurtleSkin High Density Guard material used in Schwalbe tires such as the Ultremo, Marathon Supreme, and DD Racing Ralph lines. The company's materials engineers work directly with customers on design specifications and system development.

Warwick emphasizes a cooperative development philosophy that combines engineering and manufacturing under one roof. It states that designing with manufacturing in mind yields a seamless development strategy with shorter production times. The firm highlights its integrated development and manufacturing capabilities as a unique advantage in the protective textiles industry, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification.
